youtube.title: Morning Prayer for Today | Psalm 16:8 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Keep this one in front of you all day.

"I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved." Psalm 16:8 (KJV)

If he's at your right hand, you're not walking into anything alone.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.
